newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINMIN KOCARNIK SAYS SEES FY 96 GDP +4.5 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINMIN KOCARNIK SAYS SEES FY 96 GDP +4.5 PCT.

text.p: Czech Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik said on Tuesday that he expected full year 1996 GDP growth of "up to" 4.5 percent, slightly below earlier government forecasts of 4.8 percent.
He added that the average inflation rate for 1996 would be "just under" nine percent.
"Economic growth will be somewhere around up to 4.5 percent. This growth (though under earlier forecasts) is still very good," Kocarnik told a newsconference.
The government had originally forecast inflation to ease to about eight percent, but revised upward its estimate to about 8.3 percent in the summer. Average inflation for 1995 was 9.1 percent.
Kocarnik also denied local media reports on the weekend that the government had issued some three billion crowns worth of treasury bills near the end of 1996 to help create a budget surplus.
